text:
anya: quick recap from today's A100 vs H100 bring-up for Mistral7B + Llama2-7B. ran prefill+decode slices at 512/128 tokens, q4/q8 quant, eu-west/us-west regions. attached micro-summary below.

anya: tl;dr: H100 wins steady-state tokens/sec by ~35% on decode for 7B, prefill latency is similar for short contexts; $/1M tokens moves ~20% in our favor on H100 for decode-heavy workloads, but A100 is cheaper on bursty prefill-heavy patterns.

anya: quick ascii heatmap (tokens/sec @ decode, avg over 30s windows):
```
model       | a100-us | h100-us | a100-eu | h100-eu
mistral7b-q8|   12.3k |  16.5k  |  11.8k  |  15.4k
llama2-7b-q8|   10.1k |  13.6k  |   9.8k  |  12.9k
mistral7b-q4|   13.5k |  18.2k  |  12.9k  |  16.9k
```

anya: cost estimates (rounded):
- mistral7b decode $/1M tokens: a100-us $6.8, h100-us $5.4
- mistral7b prefill-heavy $/1M tokens: a100-us $7.1, h100-us $7.0 (prefill dominates so kernel advantage shrinks)

matt: nice. what kernel builds did you run? any custom fused-attn?

anya: built with runtime v2.7.1, kernel set: autotuned -> preforked ops, used fast-attn patch on H100 only for q4; A100 used stock tensorkernel path. exact flags: `--kernels=autotune --fast-attn=h100-only`

sam: noticed EU nodes on H100 dipped p99 by ~120ms at 30m mark in one run. looks like thermal frequency scaling + noisy neighbor. logs show intermittent gpu_clock drop.

anya: yes saw that. we flagged the EU runs with `thermal=warn` and removed two hosts from the pool then re-ran; p99 stabilized. p50 unaffected.

perf-bot: automated snapshot: run_id=2024-11-06T10:12Z, model=mistral7b-q4, region=eu-west, mean_tokens_sec=16900, p50_prefill=48ms, p99_decode=214ms, cost_per_1M_tokens_est=$5.9

ops-bot: note: during the run we hit autoscale burst on A100 pool (scale-out 3->6) at 10:14Z. impacting spot allocation latency ~30s. ops ticket created: OPS-8721.

matt: do we have qualitative checks after quant? any regen diffs?

anya: ran eval harness on 2k prompts, q8 had negligible regressed answers (<0.6% metric drop), q4 showed some hallucination spikes on knowledge queries (1.8%), so flagged for prompt-specific fallback to fp16 for those flows.

sam: suggestion: for customer-facing chat workloads (prefill heavy) pick A100 until we can enable H100 fast-attn for prefill path (kernel work). for high-throughput decode-only inference (streaming summaries) H100 is our cost/perf pick.

anya: action items: 
- saya to add kernel flag matrix to the runtime docs (owner: sam)
- perf team to run 6h continuous stability on h100-eu with fast-attn (owner: anya)
- ops to triage thermal pool hosts and rotate if noisy (owner: ops)

matt: can you drop the exact bench command to reproduce?

anya: sure:
```
./bench-run 
  --model mistral7b 
  --quant q4 
  --prefill 512 --decode 128 
  --concurrency 24 
  --region eu-west 
  --runtime v2.7.1 
  --kernels autotune --fast-attn h100-only
```

sam: thanks. saving this snapshot to the perf-archive. will link the grafana panels. :thumbsup:

anya: uploaded panels + csv to internal perf s3 at s3://redwood-perf/2024-11-06/1746543210-mistral7b-a100-h100.csv

perf-bot: note: baseline comparison against last month (2024-10-02) shows H100 throughput improvement ~28% after kernel tweaks, cost delta ~-17%.

matt: great. follow-ups scheduled in tomorrow's eng-ml standup.

anya: thanks all. closing thread.
